title: Premium Instalment Entries on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## When an instalment is billed

An instalment falls due for each premium period on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan held on instalments
and invoiced to a store credit account the profile settles on terms. A plan whose premium is not invoiced to
such an account is priced as the premium billing rules of the product state, and nothing in this rule changes
what it pays.

The instalment is billed for the period running from the plan's billing day in the month reached to the day
before that day in the month following. The entry raises the premium the customer still owes on that plan by
the amount billed, and the customer sees the instalment on the plan's premium history and on what the account
owes.

## Recording the entry

The instalment is recorded with `bill_premium_instalment_3dd4c03b`, a care desk tool that is not open by
default: it is unlocked and then called by the agent handling the plan. One call books a single instalment
entry against the named plan for the period given and raises the premium outstanding on that plan by the
amount billed, so the plan's figure and its premium history agree straight away.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the instalment is billed on, read from the plan record retrieved for this customer. |
| `instalment_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: the instalment being billed, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `period_start` | A fixed-format date: the first day of the premium period being billed, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the retailer's own local calendar with no time part. There is no empty value. |
| `period_end` | A fixed-format date: the last day of that premium period, inclusive, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the retailer's own local calendar with no time part. There is no empty value. |
| `channel` | An enumerated value: where the instalment was raised from, one of `store`, a branch counter with the customer present; `web`, the customer's online account pages; `phone`, a care representative on a telephone call; `mobile_app`, the retailer's mobile application; `business_desk`, the business sales desk for a business profile. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new instalment entry, a string
beginning pin_, the plan and the period it was billed for, the amount billed in USD to two decimal places,
and the premium now outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Instalment
billed" means the entry was written and the plan's outstanding premium was raised.
